name: Rory Kyoko
source:
A talented bull descendant, and Lars's childhood friend. With the courage to defy her family legacy as a blacksmith heiress, Rory embarks on a path that showcases her true potential as a puppet master to the world.

[From [url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/love-amidst-the-timeless-rift]official profile[/url]]
